form:FormGroup.label: File Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Format of the downloaded file: Excel, CSV, TSV or Markdown. Default is Excel.
Downloads every table that uses the same query, each on its own sheet of one Excel file, not just this table. Only available when File Type is Excel. Default is not ticked.
Downloads a random sample of the rows rather than all of them. Set the size with Sample Size (%). Default is not ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Sample Size (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Approximate percentage of rows to include in a sample download, from 1 to 100. Used only when Sample Only is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 1 to 100 percent. Used only when Sample Only is ticked.
